title: Too wide for some breads, a little shaky.
text:
Too wide for some breads, a little shaky.. There is a crumb catcher for the crumbs to fall beneath the bread.
Take them out, and You can let them dry, and use them for bread crumbs when cooking, with out any additives in them.
This bread slicer folds down on the sides to be able to put away with out taking up allot of space.

I make bread and I also buy sourdough breads etc.
I thought this would be great for cutting uniformed slices!
If the bread is smaller then the with of this it’s all over the place, and I still have to
Hold it tight in place, and the bread is not even.
If I want wider bread there is not a way to get a wider slice. Guess you can cut every other slice, but
It’s too wide.

We like sourdough bread to be more chunky, not happening with these types of slicer.
When I make a regular healthy bread it’s not as wide still, but I can get the same size slices, but
My family also likes bigger and different sizes. This is not working well for my family
Or me.

If you want the same size uniform slices this is the slicer for You.

This Also does not feel real stable.

features: 100% Natural Bamboo - Not only is it durable and easy to clean, but it provides that Five Star feel, taking your kitchen to the next level!
Extra Wide - Built to handle loafs up to 6 inches wide! All it took was a bit of extra engineering, and we wanted to make sure this could handle (just about) every delicious loaf you threw at it.

Easy Clean - The included serving tray doubles as a crumb catcher, virtually eliminating the time needed to clean up! When you're done, simply dump the crumbs in the trash and wipe it out with a damp cloth. Done.

Foldable And Compact - We said it's nice and wide already, but what about when it's not in use? Well, simply fold the sides down, and voila! Now you can store it without having to sacrifice valuable counter space.
